title: Ravana sends demons to wake up Kumbhakarna
introduction: Ravana returns to Lanka and asks some demons to go to the abode of sleeping Kumbhakarna, to wake him up and request him to come to him. The slumbering Kumbhakarna is roused by the demons under orders of their king. Kumbhakarna, giant in form, sets out on the high way to see Ravana and the monkeys get alarmed to see the giant demon.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकांडे षष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 60th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
स प्रविश्य पुरीम् लङ्काम् रामबाणभयार्दितः |
भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः
verses.iast:
sa praviśya purīm laṇ^kām rāmabāṇabhayārditaḥ |
bhagnadarpastadā rājā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Returning to the City of Lanka, Ravana the King of Demons was afflicted with the fear of Rama's arrows, his pride was humbled and his senses troubled.

glosses.meaning: afflicted with the fear of Rama's arrows

verses.devanagari:
मातङ्ग इव सिम्हेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः |
अभिभूतोऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना
verses.iast:
mātaṇ^ga iva simhena garuḍeneva pannagaḥ |
abhibhūto'bhavadrājā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: The king was overcome by the high-souled Rama, like an elephant is by a lion or a serpent by an eagle.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतीकानाम् विद्युच्चलितवर्चसाम् |
स्मतन् राघवबाणानाम् विव्यथे राक्षसेश्वरः
verses.iast:
brahmadaṇḍapratīkānām vidyuccalitavarcasām |
smatan rāghavabāṇānām vivyathe rākṣaseśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Lord of Demons was maddened in recollecting Rama's arrows resembling the Rod of Brahma the Lord of creation and possessed of the splendour of lightning.

glosses.meaning: resembling the Rod of Brahma the Lord of creation
and possessed of the splendour of lightning.

verses.devanagari:
स काञ्चनमयम् दिव्यमाश्रित्य परमासनम् |
विप्रेक्षमाणो रक्षांसि रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa kāJṇcanamayam divyamāśritya paramāsanam |
viprekṣamāṇo rakṣāṃsi rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: Resting on an excellent and charming throne made of gold, Ravana looked at the demons and spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
सर्वम् तत्खलु मे मोघम् यत्तप्तम् परमम् तपः |
यत्समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेण विनिर्जितः
verses.iast:
sarvam tatkhalu me mogham yattaptam paramam tapaḥ |
yatsamāno mahendreṇa mānuṣeṇa vinirjitaḥ
verses.translation: "All that great penance performed by me became a waste indeed, for, I who am equal to Mahendra the Lord of Celestials have been defeated by a mere man!"

glosses.meaning: I who am equal to Mahendra the Lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
इदम् तद्ब्रह्मणो घोरम् वाक्यम् मामभ्युपस्थितम् |
मानुषेभ्यो विजानीहि भयम् त्वमिति तत्तथा
verses.iast:
idam tadbrahmaṇo ghoram vākyam māmabhyupasthitam |
mānuṣebhyo vijānīhi bhayam tvamiti tattathā
verses.translation: "The terrible words of Brahma the Lord of Creation saying, 'You know of the threat from men' appear true. That is so."

glosses.meaning: of Brahma the Lord of creation

verses.devanagari:
देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः |
अवध्यत्वम् मया प्राप्तम् मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम्
verses.iast:
devadānavagandharvairyakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ |
avadhyatvam mayā prāptam mānuṣebhyo na yācitam
verses.translation: "I sought immunity from death at the hands of celestials, titans or celestials musicians, or semi divine beings or demons or serpent-demons, but f man I made no mention."

glosses.meaning: or sam-divine beings or demons or serpent-demons

verses.devanagari:
विदितम् मानुषम् मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम् |
इक्ष्वाकुकुलजातेन अनर्ण्येन यत् पुरा
उत्पत्स्यति हि मद्वंशे पुरुषो राक्षसाधम |
यस्त्वाम् सपुत्रम् सामात्यम् सबलम् साश्वसारथिम्
निहनिष्यति सम्ग्रामे त्वाम् कुलाधम दुर्मते |
verses.iast:
viditam mānuṣam manye rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam |
ikṣvākukulajātena anarṇyena yat purā
utpatsyati hi madvaṃśe puruṣo rākṣasādhama |
yastvām saputram sāmātyam sabalam sāśvasārathim
nihaniṣyati samgrāme tvām kulādhama durmate |
verses.translation: "Rama the son of Dasaratha is the man I think of whom Anaranya born of Ikshvaku dynasty formerly spoke, saying: 'O, the worst of demons, the worst of your race and the wretched one! In my race will be born a man who will slay you in battle with your sons, ministers, army, horses and charioteer."

verses.devanagari:
शप्तोऽहम् वेदवत्या च यदा सा धर्षिता पुरा
सेयम् सीता महाभागा जाता जनकनन्दिनी |
verses.iast:
śapto'ham vedavatyā ca yadā sā dharṣitā purā
seyam sītā mahābhāgā jātā janakanandinī |
verses.translation: "Further, I was formerly cursed by Vedavati when she was humiliated by me. The same Vedavati is born as the highly fortunate Seetha the daughter of Janaka."

verses.devanagari:
उमा नन्दीश्वरश्चापि रम्भा वरुणकन्यका
यथोक्तास्तन्मया प्राप्तम् न मिध्या ऋषिभाषितम् |
verses.iast:
umā nandīśvaraścāpi rambhā varuṇakanyakā
yathoktāstanmayā prāptam na midhyā ṛṣibhāṣitam |
verses.translation: "What was predicted by Parvati the consort of Shiva, Nandishvara the attendant of Shiva, Rambha the wife of Nalakubara and Punjikasthala the daughter of Varunda has come to pass! The words of the sages never prove false."

glosses.meaning: lord Nandi the attendant of Shiva

verses.devanagari:
एतदेवाभ्युपागम्य यत्नम् कर्तुमहार्हथ
राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु |
verses.iast:
etadevābhyupāgamya yatnam kartumahārhatha
rākṣasāścāpi tiṣṭhantu caryāgopuramūrdhasu |
verses.translation: "On account of all this and admitting it, you should exert yourselves to the uttermost. Let the demons go to the summit of Charya Mountain."

glosses.meaning: on the summit of Charya Mountian.

verses.devanagari:
स चाप्रतिमगाम्भीर्यो देवदानवदर्पहा
ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तु कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् |
verses.iast:
sa cāpratimagāmbhīryo devadānavadarpahā
brahmaśāpābhibhūtastu kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām |
verses.translation: "Awaken that kumbhakarna, who is without equal in prowess, who humbles the pride of the celestials and demons, and on whom the curse of Brahma the Lord of creation rests."

glosses.meaning: who is without equal in prowess
who humbles the pride of the celestials and demons
and on whom the curse of Brahma the Lord of Creation rests.

verses.devanagari:
समरे जितमात्मानम् प्रहस्तम् च निषूदितम्
ज्ञात्वा रक्षोबलम् भीममादिदेश महाबलः |
verses.iast:
samare jitamātmānam prahastam ca niṣūditam
jJṇātvā rakṣobalam bhīmamādideśa mahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: Having known that Prahasta being slain and knowing himself to have been defeated in the battle, Ravana issued his commands tot he dreadful army, saying:

verses.devanagari:
द्वारेषु यत्नः क्रियताम् प्राकारश्चाधिरुह्यताम्
निद्रावशसमाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् |
verses.iast:
dvāreṣu yatnaḥ kriyatām prākāraścādhiruhyatām
nidrāvaśasamāviṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo vibodhyatām |
verses.translation: "Guard the gates with utmost care. Man the ramparts. Rouse Kumbhakarna who is slumbering soundly."

verses.devanagari:
सुखम् स्वपिति निश्चिन्तः कालोपहतचेतनः
नव सप्त दशाष्टौ च मासान् स्वपिति राक्षसः |
verses.iast:
sukham svapiti niścintaḥ kālopahatacetanaḥ
nava sapta daśāṣṭau ca māsān svapiti rākṣasaḥ |
verses.translation: "Kumbhakarna is sleeping happily, his understanding vitiated by lust and free from all anxieties. The demon sleeps for nine, seven, ten or eight months.

verses.devanagari:
मन्त्रम् कृत्वा प्रसुप्तोऽयमिअस्तु नवमेऽहनि
तम् तु बोधयत क्षिप्रम् कुम्भकर्णम् महाबलम् |
verses.iast:
mantram kṛtvā prasupto'yamiastu navame'hani
tam tu bodhayata kṣipram kumbhakarṇam mahābalam |
verses.translation: "Having deliberated with me nine days ago, he has since fallen asleep. Awaken quickly that mighty Kumbhakarna."

verses.devanagari:
स हि सम्ख्ये महाबाहुः ककुदम् सर्वरक्षसाम्
वानरान् राजपुत्रौ च क्षिप्रमेव हनिष्यति |
verses.iast:
sa hi samkhye mahābāhuḥ kakudam sarvarakṣasām
vānarān rājaputrau ca kṣiprameva haniṣyati |
verses.translation: "The mighty armed Kumbhakarna, the foremost of all demons will kill the monkeys and the two princes at once in the battle."

verses.devanagari:
एष केतुः परं सम्ख्ये मुख्ये वै सर्वरक्षसाम्
कुम्भकर्णः सदा शेते मूढो ग्राम्यसुखे रतः |
verses.iast:
eṣa ketuḥ paraṃ samkhye mukhye vai sarvarakṣasām
kumbhakarṇaḥ sadā śete mūḍho grāmyasukhe rataḥ |
verses.translation: "This Kumbhakarna, the chief among all the demons and a great mark in the battle, being fond of a rustic comfort, is always sleeping stupidly."

verses.devanagari:
रामेणाभिनिरस्तस्य सम्ग्रामेऽस्मिन् सुदारुणे
भविष्यति न मे शोकः कुम्भकर्णे विबोधिते |
verses.iast:
rāmeṇābhinirastasya samgrāme'smin sudāruṇe
bhaviṣyati na me śokaḥ kumbhakarṇe vibodhite |
verses.translation: "If Kumbhakarna is awaken, there will be no worry for me, who stand defeated by Rama in this highly terrific battle."

verses.devanagari:
किम् करिष्याम्यहम् तेन शक्रतुल्यबलेन हि
ईदृशे व्यसने घोरे यो न साह्याय कल्पते |
verses.iast:
kim kariṣyāmyaham tena śakratulyabalena hi
īdṛśe vyasane ghore yo na sāhyāya kalpate |
verses.translation: "What is the use of him, who possessing a strength equal to that of Indra the Lord of celestials, cannot help me in such a dreadful catastrophe?"

verses.devanagari:
ते तु तद्वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः
जग्मुः परमसम्भ्रान्ताः कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् |
verses.iast:
te tu tadvacanam śrutvā rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ
jagmuḥ paramasambhrāntāḥ kumbhakarṇaniveśanam |
verses.translation: Hearing those words of Ravana, those demons very briskly went to the abode of Kumbhakarna.

glosses.meaning: of Ravana the Lord of Demons

verses.devanagari:
ताम् प्रविश्य महाद्वाराम् सर्वतो योजनायताम्
कुम्भक्र्णगुहाम् रम्याम् पुष्पगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् |
कुम्भकर्णस्य निःश्वासादवधूता महाबलाः
प्रतिष्ठमानाः कृच्छ्रेण यत्ना त्प्रविविशुर्गुहाम् |
verses.iast:
tām praviśya mahādvārām sarvato yojanāyatām
kumbhakrṇaguhām ramyām puṣpagandhapravāhinīm |
kumbhakarṇasya niḥśvāsādavadhūtā mahābalāḥ
pratiṣṭhamānāḥ kṛcchreṇa yatnā tpraviviśurguhām |
verses.translation: Entering the beautiful cave of Kumbhakarna, with a large door, having an area of a Yojana on all sides and bearing a floral perfume, the demons of mighty strength, though shaken off by Kumbhakarna's breaths, remained stable forcefully with difficulty and went into the cave.

glosses.meaning: having an area of Yojana (About 9 miles x 9 miles)

verses.devanagari:
ताम् प्रविश्य गुहाम् रम्याम् रत्नकाञ्चनकुट्टिमाम्
ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्राः शयानम् भीमविक्रमम् |
verses.iast:
tām praviśya guhām ramyām ratnakāJṇcanakuṭṭimām
dadṛśurnairṛtavyāghrāḥ śayānam bhīmavikramam |
verses.translation: Entering that beautiful cave inlaid with diamonds and gold, those tigers among demons beheld Kumbhakarna, of terrific prowess, who was sleeping.

verses.devanagari:
ते तु तम् विकृतम् सुप्तम् विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम्
कुम्भम् महानिद्रम् समेताः प्रत्यबोधयन् |
verses.iast:
te tu tam vikṛtam suptam vikīrṇamiva parvatam
kumbham mahānidram sametāḥ pratyabodhayan |
verses.translation: They together tried to awaken Kumbhakarna who was sleeping nastily like a spread-out mountain in a great slumber.

verses.devanagari:
ऊर्ध्वलोमाञ्चिततनुम् श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम्
भ्रामयन्तम् विनिःश्वासैः शयानम् भीमविक्रमम् |
भीमनासापुटम् तम् तु पातालविपुलाननम्
शयने न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गम् मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् |
काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गम् मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम्
ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रम् कुम्भकर्णमरिन्दमम् |
verses.iast:
ūrdhvalomāJṇcitatanum śvasantamiva pannagam
bhrāmayantam viniḥśvāsaiḥ śayānam bhīmavikramam |
bhīmanāsāpuṭam tam tu pātālavipulānanam
śayane nyastasarvāṇ^gam medorudhiragandhinam |
kāJṇcanāṇ^gadanaddhāṇ^gam medorudhiragandhinam
dadṛśurnairṛtavyāghram kumbhakarṇamarindamam |
verses.translation: His limbs covered with down which stood on end, breathing like a serpent, as he slept, Kumbhakarna of irresistible valour emitted dreadful snores, his nostrils being horrible, and his mouth a gaping hell. Stretched to his full length on the earth, he gave forth an odour of marrow and blood, his limbs were adorned with golden armlets and he wore a diadem as bright as the sun, thus did that lion among demons, Kumbhakarna, the slayer of his foes, appear!

glosses.meaning: his limbs covered with down which stood on end
and his mouth a gaping hell
stretched to his full length of body
giving forth an odour of marrow and blood
his limbs adorned with goldedn armlets
and the slayer of his foes

verses.devanagari:
ततश्चक्रुर्महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णस्य चाग्रातः
भूतानाम् मेरुसम्काशम् राशिम् परमतर्पणम् |
verses.iast:
tataścakrurmahātmānaḥ kumbhakarṇasya cāgrātaḥ
bhūtānām merusamkāśam rāśim paramatarpaṇam |
verses.translation: Then, those powerful demons, in order to satisfy him, placed a heap of venison as high as Mount Meru, in front of Kumbhakarna.

glosses.meaning: in order to satisfy him excellently
as high as mount Meru agrataH = in front

verses.devanagari:
मृगाणाम् महिषाणाम् च वराहाणाम् च संचयान्
चक्रुर्नैरृतशार्दूला राशिमन्नस्य चाद्भुतम् |
verses.iast:
mṛgāṇām mahiṣāṇām ca varāhāṇām ca saṃcayān
cakrurnairṛtaśārdūlā rāśimannasya cādbhutam |
verses.translation: Those excellent demons piled up a great mass of wonderful food with the meat of deers, buffaloes and pigs.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शोणितकुम्भांश्च मांसानि विविधानि च
पुरस्तात्कुम्भकर्णस्य चक्रुस्त्रिदशशत्रवः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ śoṇitakumbhāṃśca māṃsāni vividhāni ca
purastātkumbhakarṇasya cakrustridaśaśatravaḥ |
verses.translation: Then, the demons placed pots of blood and various kinds of meat in front of Kumbhakarna.

verses.devanagari:
लिलिपुश्च परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परम्तपम्
दिव्यैराश्वासयामासुर्माल्यैर्गन्धैश्च गन्धिभिः |
verses.iast:
lilipuśca parārdhyena candanena paramtapam
divyairāśvāsayāmāsurmālyairgandhaiśca gandhibhiḥ |
verses.translation: They rubbed Kumbhakarna the scourge of his foes with the most rare sandalwood and refreshed him with celestial and fragrant garlands as well as sweet-smelling perfumes.

verses.devanagari:
धूपगन्धांश्च ससृजुस्तुष्टुवुश्च परम्तपम्
जलदा इव चानेदुर्यातुधानास्ततस्ततः |
verses.iast:
dhūpagandhāṃśca sasṛjustuṣṭuvuśca paramtapam
jaladā iva cāneduryātudhānāstatastataḥ |
verses.translation: They burnt incenses and hymned the praises of that warrior who proved fatal to his foes. They cried out noises which burst forth on every side like thunder.

glosses.meaning: of that warrior who proved fatal to his foes

verses.devanagari:
शङ्खांश्च पूरयामासुः शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान्
तुमुलम् युगपच्चापि विनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः |
verses.iast:
śaṇ^khāṃśca pūrayāmāsuḥ śaśāṇ^kasadṛśaprabhān
tumulam yugapaccāpi vineduścāpyamarṣitāḥ |
verses.translation: They blew couches which were as bright as the moon and with impatience, made with impatience, made sounds tumultuously all at once.

verses.devanagari:
नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः
कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थम् चक्रुस्तेविपुलम् स्वनम् |
verses.iast:
nedurāsphoṭayāmāsuścikṣipuste niśācarāḥ
kumbhakarṇavibodhārtham cakrustevipulam svanam |
verses.translation: Those demons made sounds by clapping their hands, in order to awaken Kumbhakarna and shook him too, creating a great clamour.

verses.devanagari:
सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणाद |
मास्फोटितक्ष्वेलितसिम्हनादम् |
दिशो द्रवन्तस्त्रिदिवम् किरन्तः |
श्रुत्वा विहम्गाः सहसा निपेतुः
verses.iast:
saśaṇ^khabherīpaṇavapraṇāda |
māsphoṭitakṣvelitasimhanādam |
diśo dravantastridivam kirantaḥ |
śrutvā vihamgāḥ sahasā nipetuḥ
verses.translation: The birds passing through the sky ran helter-shelter and fell down soon on hearing the sounds of the couches, drums, gongs, clapping of hands and leonine roars.

glosses.meaning: clapping of hands and leonine roars.

verses.devanagari:
यदा भृशम् तैर्निनदैर्महात्मा |
न कम्भकर्णो बुबुधे प्रसुप्तः |
ततो भुशुण्डीर्मुसलानि सर्वे |
रक्षोगणास्तम् जगृहुर्गदाश्च
verses.iast:
yadā bhṛśam tairninadairmahātmā |
na kambhakarṇo bubudhe prasuptaḥ |
tato bhuśuṇḍīrmusalāni sarve |
rakṣogaṇāstam jagṛhurgadāśca
verses.translation: As the illustrious Kumbhakarna did not waken from his slumber despite those great sounds, all troops of demons seized hold of bars, pestles and maces towards him.

verses.devanagari:
तम् शैलशृङ्गेर्मुसलैर्गदाभि |
र्वक्षःस्थले मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च |
सुखप्रसुप्तम् भुवि कुम्भकर्णम् |
रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नः
verses.iast:
tam śailaśṛṇ^germusalairgadābhi |
rvakṣaḥsthale mudgaramuṣṭibhiśca |
sukhaprasuptam bhuvi kumbhakarṇam |
rakṣāṃsyudagrāṇi tadā nijaghnaḥ
verses.translation: Then, the cruel demons struck that sleeping Kumbhakarna on his chest with mountain-tops, pestles, maces, hammers and their fists.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य निःश्वासवातेन कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः |
राक्षसा बलवन्तोऽपि स्थातुम् शेकुर्न चाग्रतः
verses.iast:
tasya niḥśvāsavātena kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ |
rākṣasā balavanto'pi sthātum śekurna cāgrataḥ
verses.translation: Even with all their strength, the demons could not stand upright before the breathing winds of Kumbhakarna, the demon.

verses.devanagari:
ततः परिहिता गाढम् राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः |
मृदङ्गपणवान् भेरीः शङ्खकुम्भगणांस्तथा
verses.iast:
tataḥ parihitā gāḍham rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ |
mṛdaṇ^gapaṇavān bherīḥ śaṇ^khakumbhagaṇāṃstathā
verses.translation: Then, the terribly strong demons firmly seated themselves round him and began to beat drums, cymbals, kettle-drums and myriads of couches and trumpets.

glosses.meaning: and shaNkha kumbhagaNaam = myriads of couches and trumpets.

verses.devanagari:
दश राक्षससाहस्रम् युगपत्पर्यवारयत् |
नीलञ्जनचयाकारम् ते तु तम् प्रत्य्बोधयन्
अभिघ्नन्तो नदन्तश्च न च सम्बुबुधे तदा |
verses.iast:
daśa rākṣasasāhasram yugapatparyavārayat |
nīlaJṇjanacayākāram te tu tam pratybodhayan
abhighnanto nadantaśca na ca sambubudhe tadā |
verses.translation: Ten thousand demons surrounded him all at once. Beating that colossus who resembled a heap of antimony, the demons on their part tried to rouse him by making sounds. Even then, he did not wake.

glosses.meaning: that colossus who resembled a heap of antimony

verses.devanagari:
यदा चैनम् न शेकुस्ते प्रतिबोधयितुम् तदा
ततो गुरुतरम् यत्नम् दारुणम् समुपाक्रमन् |
verses.iast:
yadā cainam na śekuste pratibodhayitum tadā
tato gurutaram yatnam dāruṇam samupākraman |
verses.translation: As they were unable to rouse him by these means, they resorted to more energetic and ruthless methods.

verses.devanagari:
अश्वानुष्ट्रान् खरान्नागान् जघ्नर्दण्डकशाङ्कुशैः
भेरीशङ्खेमृदङ्गांश्च सर्वप्राणैरवादयन् |
verses.iast:
aśvānuṣṭrān kharānnāgān jaghnardaṇḍakaśāṇ^kuśaiḥ
bherīśaṇ^khemṛdaṇ^gāṃśca sarvaprāṇairavādayan |
verses.translation: They beat horses, camels, donkeys, and elephants with sticks whips and thongs, so that they trample upon him and blasted kettle-drums, couches and drums.

verses.devanagari:
निजघ्नश्चास्य गात्राणि महाकाष्ठकटम्करैः
मुद्गरैर्मुसलैश्चापि सर्वप्राणसमुद्यतैः |
verses.iast:
nijaghnaścāsya gātrāṇi mahākāṣṭhakaṭamkaraiḥ
mudgarairmusalaiścāpi sarvaprāṇasamudyataiḥ |
verses.translation: They crushed his limbs under piles of heavy logs and pillars, as also maces lifted with all their strength.

glosses.meaning: under piles of heavy logs and pillars

verses.devanagari:
तेन नादेन महाअ लङ्का समभिपूरिता
सपर्वतवना सर्वा सोऽपि नैव प्रबुध्यते |
verses.iast:
tena nādena mahāa laṇ^kā samabhipūritā
saparvatavanā sarvā so'pi naiva prabudhyate |
verses.translation: The entire Lanka, with its mountain and groves, was filled with great noise. He nevertheless did not wake.

glosses.meaning: along with its mountains and groves

verses.devanagari:
ततः सहस्रम् भेरीणाम् युगपत्समहन्यत
मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणाना मासक्तानाम् समन्ततः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sahasram bherīṇām yugapatsamahanyata
mṛṣṭakāJṇcanakoṇānā māsaktānām samantataḥ |
verses.translation: Then, they beat a thousand drums all around with sticks of refined gold.

verses.devanagari:
एवनओततुबुद्रस्त्य् तदा बौव ओरव्य्द्ग्तत
शापस्य वशमापन्नस्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः |
verses.iast:
evanaotatubudrasty tadā bauva oravydgtata
śāpasya vaśamāpannastataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ |
verses.translation: Yet, as he did not wake from his profound slumber, being under the spell of a curse, the demons were enraged.

verses.devanagari:
महाक्रोधसमाविष्टाः सर्वे भीमपराक्रमाः
तद्रक्षो बोधयिष्यन्तश्चक्रुरन्ये पराक्रमम् |
verses.iast:
mahākrodhasamāviṣṭāḥ sarve bhīmaparākramāḥ
tadrakṣo bodhayiṣyantaścakruranye parākramam |
verses.translation: All those demons of terrible strength were filled with a great fury. Some others assembled their strength to awaken that demon.

glosses.meaning: were filled with a great fury

verses.devanagari:
अन्ये भेरीः समाजघ्नरन्ये चक्रुर्महास्वनम्
केशानन्ये प्रलुलुपुः कर्णावन्ये दशन्ति च |
verses.iast:
anye bherīḥ samājaghnaranye cakrurmahāsvanam
keśānanye pralulupuḥ karṇāvanye daśanti ca |
verses.translation: Some beat drums, some shouted, some tore out his hair and some others bit his ears.

verses.devanagari:
उदकुम्भशतान्यन्ये समसिञ्चन्त कर्णयोः
न कुम्भकर्णः पस्पन्दे महानिद्रावशं गतः |
verses.iast:
udakumbhaśatānyanye samasiJṇcanta karṇayoḥ
na kumbhakarṇaḥ paspande mahānidrāvaśaṃ gataḥ |
verses.translation: Some poured hundreds of pitchers of water into his ears but Kumbhakarna, plunged in deep sleep, did not stir.

verses.devanagari:
न कुम्भकर्णः पस्पन्दे महानिद्रावशम् गतः
मूर्ध्नि वक्षसि गात्रेषु पातयन् कूटमुद्गरान् |
verses.iast:
na kumbhakarṇaḥ paspande mahānidrāvaśam gataḥ
mūrdhni vakṣasi gātreṣu pātayan kūṭamudgarān |
verses.translation: Some strong ones, armed with rocks and hammers, struck the rocks and hammers on his head, chest and other limbs.

verses.devanagari:
रज्जुबन्धनबद्धाभिः शतग्नीभिश्च सर्वशः
वध्यमानो महाकायो न प्राबुध्यत राक्षसः |
verses.iast:
rajjubandhanabaddhābhiḥ śatagnībhiśca sarvaśaḥ
vadhyamāno mahākāyo na prābudhyata rākṣasaḥ |
verses.translation: Though smitten by missiles fastened with ropes on all sides, the giant bodied demon did not wake.

verses.devanagari:
वारणानाम् सहस्रम् च शरीरेऽस्य प्रधावितम्
कुम्भकर्णस्तदा बुद्ध्वा स्पर्शम् परमबुध्यत |
verses.iast:
vāraṇānām sahasram ca śarīre'sya pradhāvitam
kumbhakarṇastadā buddhvā sparśam paramabudhyata |
verses.translation: A thousand elephants ran up and down on his body till Kumbhakarna lightly woke up and became aware of the pressure.

verses.devanagari:
स पात्यमानैर्गिरिशृङ्गवृक्षै |
रचिन्तयंस्तान्विपुलान् प्रहारान् |
निद्राक्षयात् क्षुद्भयपीडितश्च |
विजृम्भमाणः सहसोत्पपाप
verses.iast:
sa pātyamānairgiriśṛṇ^gavṛkṣai |
racintayaṃstānvipulān prahārān |
nidrākṣayāt kṣudbhayapīḍitaśca |
vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ sahasotpapāpa
verses.translation: Being insensible to those violent blows of crags and trees hurled upon him, but under the prompting of extreme hunger, Kumbhakarna suddenly sprang up from sleep, yawning due to loss of sleep.

glosses.meaning: but under the prompting of extreme hunger

verses.devanagari:
स नागभोगाचलशृङ्गकल्पौ |
विक्षिप्य बाहू जितवज्रसारौ |
विवृत्य वक्त्रम् वडवामुखाभम् |
निशाचरोऽसौ विकृतम् जजृम्भे
verses.iast:
sa nāgabhogācalaśṛṇ^gakalpau |
vikṣipya bāhū jitavajrasārau |
vivṛtya vaktram vaḍavāmukhābham |
niśācaro'sau vikṛtam jajṛmbhe
verses.translation: Waving his arms resembling serpent's coils or the peaks of mountains, hard as cut diamonds, that demons opening his monstrous month like unto the face of a submarine fire, yawned.

glosses.meaning: resembling serpent's coils or the peaks of mountains
like unto the face of a submarine fire

verses.devanagari:
तस्य जाजृम्भमाणस्य वक्त्रम् पातालसम्निभम् |
दद्ऱ्^उशे मेरुशृङ्गाग्रे दिवाकर इवोदितः
verses.iast:
tasya jājṛmbhamāṇasya vaktram pātālasamnibham |
dadR^uśe meruśṛṇ^gāgre divākara ivoditaḥ
verses.translation: His mouth yawning horribly resembled hell and appeared like the sun rising under the high peak of Meru Mountain.

glosses.meaning: under the high peak of Meru Mountain.

verses.devanagari:
स जृम्भमाणोऽतिबलः प्रबुद्धस्तु निशाचरः |
निःश्वासश्चास्य सम्जज्ञे पर्वदादिव मारुतः
verses.iast:
sa jṛmbhamāṇo'tibalaḥ prabuddhastu niśācaraḥ |
niḥśvāsaścāsya samjajJṇe parvadādiva mārutaḥ
verses.translation: That mighty demon, being awake, yawned, heaving a sigh, like unto a tempest arising from a mountain.

verses.devanagari:
रूपमुत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य तद् बभौ |
युगाने सर्वभूतानि कालस्येव दिधक्षतः
verses.iast:
rūpamuttiṣṭhatastasya kumbhakarṇasya tad babhau |
yugāne sarvabhūtāni kālasyeva didhakṣataḥ
verses.translation: That figure of Kumbhakarna, rising up, stood out resembling Time at the dissolution of the world, prepared to devour all beings.

glosses.meaning: at the dissolution of the world

verses.devanagari:
तस्याग्निदीप्तिसदृशे विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी |
ददृशाते महानेत्रे दीप्ताविव महाग्रहौ
verses.iast:
tasyāgnidīptisadṛśe vidyutsadṛśavarcasī |
dadṛśāte mahānetre dīptāviva mahāgrahau
verses.translation: His huge eyes, resembling flames of fire, with a glitter equal to that of lightning, appeared like great blazing planets.

glosses.meaning: with a glitter equal to that of lightning

verses.devanagari:
ततस्त्वदर्शयन् सर्वान् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् बहून् |
वराहान् महिषांश्चैव बभक्ष स महाबलः
verses.iast:
tatastvadarśayan sarvān bhakṣyāṃśca vividhān bahūn |
varāhān mahiṣāṃścaiva babhakṣa sa mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Then, the demons pointed to various kinds of victuals, boar and buffalo. The mighty Kumbhakarna devoured them.

verses.devanagari:
आदद्बुभुक्षितो मांसम् शोणितम् तृषितोऽपिबत् |
मेदःकुम्भांश्च मद्यांश्च पपौ शक्ररिपुस्तदा
verses.iast:
ādadbubhukṣito māṃsam śoṇitam tṛṣito'pibat |
medaḥkumbhāṃśca madyāṃśca papau śakraripustadā
verses.translation: Then, the hungry Kumbhakarna, the enemy of Indra, ate the meat and being thirsty drank the blood and gulped pitchers full of fat and wine.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तृप्त इति ज्ञात्वा समुत्पेरुर्निशाचराः |
शिरोभिश्च प्रणम्यैनम् सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्
verses.iast:
tatastṛpta iti jJṇātvā samutperurniśācarāḥ |
śirobhiśca praṇamyainam sarvataḥ paryavārayan
verses.translation: Thereupon, knowing that Kumbhakarna was gratified of his hunger, the demons approached him, saluting him with their heads bent and surrounded him on all sides.

verses.devanagari:
निद्राविशदनेत्रस्तु कलुषीकृतलोचनः |
चारयन् सर्वतो दृष्टिम् तानुवाच निशाचरान्
verses.iast:
nidrāviśadanetrastu kaluṣīkṛtalocanaḥ |
cārayan sarvato dṛṣṭim tānuvāca niśācarān
verses.translation: Raising his eyelids that were heavy with sleep, his gaze still veiled, he directed his glance towards those demons and spoke as follows:

glosses.meaning: raising his eyelids that were heavy with sleep

verses.devanagari:
स सर्वान् सान्त्वयामास नैर्ऱ्^तान् नैरृतर्षभः |
बोधनाद्विस्मितश्चापि राक्षसानिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa sarvān sāntvayāmāsa nairR^tān nairṛtarṣabhaḥ |
bodhanādvismitaścāpi rākṣasānidamabravīt
verses.translation: That excellent demons kindly addressing all the demons and surprised at being roused, spoke the following words to the demons:

verses.devanagari:
किमर्थमहामादृत्य भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः |
कच्चित्सुकुशलम् राज्ञो भयम् वा नेह किंचन्
verses.iast:
kimarthamahāmādṛtya bhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ |
kaccitsukuśalam rājJṇo bhayam vā neha kiṃcan
verses.translation: "For what reason have you thus wakened me so suddenly? Is all well with the king or anything in peril here?"

verses.devanagari:
अथवा ध्रुवमन्येभ्यो भयम् परमुपस्थितम् |
यदर्थमेव त्वरिरैर्भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः
verses.iast:
athavā dhruvamanyebhyo bhayam paramupasthitam |
yadarthameva tvarirairbhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Surely, there must be some great danger from an external source since you have wakened me in haste."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य राक्षसराजस्य भयमुत्पाटयाम्यहम् |
दारयिष्ये महेन्द्रम् वा शीतयिष्ये तथानलम्
verses.iast:
adya rākṣasarājasya bhayamutpāṭayāmyaham |
dārayiṣye mahendram vā śītayiṣye tathānalam
verses.translation: "Now, I shall drive away the misfortune from Ravana the King of Demons, even if I have to cut Mahendra himself to pieces or to freeze the Fire.

glosses.meaning: from Ravana the King of Demons
(even if) I have to cut to pieces

verses.devanagari:
स ह्यल्पकारणे सुप्तम् बोधयिष्यति मादृशम् |
तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेन मत्प्रबोधनकारणम्
verses.iast:
sa hyalpakāraṇe suptam bodhayiṣyati mādṛśam |
tadākhyātārthatattvena matprabodhanakāraṇam
verses.translation: "For a petty reason, one does not indeed awaken, one such as I, from my slumber. Hence, tell me frankly, for what reason you have roused me."

glosses.meaning: one does not indeed awaken one
for what reason you have roused me.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सम्रब्धम् कुम्भकर्णमरिंदमम् |
यूपाक्षः सचिवो राज्ञः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇam samrabdham kumbhakarṇamariṃdamam |
yūpākṣaḥ sacivo rājJṇaḥ kṛtāJṇjalirabhāṣata
verses.translation: Yupaksha, a minister of the King, with his hands joined salutation, spoke (as follows) to Kumbhakarna, the annihilator of his enemies, thus talking excitedly.

glosses.meaning: with his hands joined in salutation

verses.devanagari:
न नो देवकृतम् किंचिद्भयमस्ति कदाचन |
मानुषान्नो भयम् राजंस्तुमुलम् सम्प्रबाधते
verses.iast:
na no devakṛtam kiṃcidbhayamasti kadācana |
mānuṣānno bhayam rājaṃstumulam samprabādhate
verses.translation: "O, Prince! There is no threat whatsoever at anytime for us from celestials but a mere man is driving us back by a tumultuous tremor."

verses.devanagari:
न दैत्यदानवेभ्यो वा भयमस्ति हि तादृशम् |
यादृशम् मानुषम् राजन् भयमस्मानुपस्थितम्
verses.iast:
na daityadānavebhyo vā bhayamasti hi tādṛśam |
yādṛśam mānuṣam rājan bhayamasmānupasthitam
verses.translation: "O, Prince! It is not indeed the celestials or demons who have put us in such a peril as it comes to us from a man."

verses.devanagari:
वानरैः पर्वताकारैर्लङ्केयम् परिवारिता |
सीताहरणसम्तप्ताद्रामान्नस्तुमुलम् भयम्
verses.iast:
vānaraiḥ parvatākārairlaṇ^keyam parivāritā |
sītāharaṇasamtaptādrāmānnastumulam bhayam
verses.translation: "Monkeys, whose forms are as large as mountains, are besieging Lanka. There is a tumultuous peril for us from Rama, who is furious on account of Seetha's abduction."

glosses.meaning: whose forms are as large as mountains
who is furious on account of Seetha's abduction.

verses.devanagari:
एकेन वानरेणेयम् पूर्वम् दग्धा महापुरी |
कुमारो निहतश्चाक्षः सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः
verses.iast:
ekena vānareṇeyam pūrvam dagdhā mahāpurī |
kumāro nihataścākṣaḥ sānuyātraḥ sakuJṇjaraḥ
verses.translation: "Already, a single monkey set fire to our great city of slew the youthful Prince Aksha with his escort of elephants and retinue."

verses.devanagari:
स्वयम् रक्षोधिपश्चापि पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः |
व्रजेति सम्युगे मुक्तो रामेणादित्यवर्चसा
verses.iast:
svayam rakṣodhipaścāpi paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ |
vrajeti samyuge mukto rāmeṇādityavarcasā
verses.translation: " ' Get thee hence' were the words addressed by Rama who is equal to the sun in splendour, to Ravana in person the Lord of Demons and the trouble-some person to celestials."

glosses.meaning: who is equal to the sun in splendour
and the troublesome person to celestials.

verses.devanagari:
यन्न देवैः कृतो राजा नापि दैत्यैर्न दानवैः |
कृतः स इह रामेण विमुक्तः प्राणसंशयात्
verses.iast:
yanna devaiḥ kṛto rājā nāpi daityairna dānavaiḥ |
kṛtaḥ sa iha rāmeṇa vimuktaḥ prāṇasaṃśayāt
verses.translation: "That which this king never suffered at the hands of Gods or Demons or Danavas, he has had to endure here from Rama, who released him from the danger to his life."

glosses.meaning: from the danger to his life.

verses.devanagari:
स यूपाक्षवचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्युधि पराभवम् |
कुम्भक्र्णो विवृत्ताक्षो यूपाक्षमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa yūpākṣavacaḥ śrutvā bhrāturyudhi parābhavam |
kumbhakrṇo vivṛttākṣo yūpākṣamidamabravīt
verses.translation: Hearing about the humiliation of his brother in the battle through the words of Yupaksha, Kumbhakarna rolling his great eyes, spoke to Yupaksha (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
सर्वमद्यैव यूपाक्ष हरिसैन्यम् सलक्ष्मणम् |
राघवम् च रणे जित्वा ततो द्रक्ष्यामि रावणम्
verses.iast:
sarvamadyaiva yūpākṣa harisainyam salakṣmaṇam |
rāghavam ca raṇe jitvā tato drakṣyāmi rāvaṇam
verses.translation: "O, Yupaksha! Now itself, after conquering the entire army of monkeys with Lakshmana and Rama on the battle-field, then only I shall see Ravana."

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसांस्तर्पयिष्यामि हरीणाम् मांसशोणितैः |
रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि स्वयम् पास्यामि शोणितम्
verses.iast:
rākṣasāṃstarpayiṣyāmi harīṇām māṃsaśoṇitaiḥ |
rāmalakṣmaṇayoścāpi svayam pāsyāmi śoṇitam
verses.translation: "I shall satiate the demons with the flesh and blood of monkeys and, as for Rama and Lakshmana, I shall drink their blood myself."

verses.devanagari:
तत्तस्य वाक्यम् ब्रुवतो निशम्य |
सगर्वितम् रोषविवृद्धदोषम् |
महोदरो नैरृतयोधमुख्यः |
कृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदम् बभाषे
verses.iast:
tattasya vākyam bruvato niśamya |
sagarvitam roṣavivṛddhadoṣam |
mahodaro nairṛtayodhamukhyaḥ |
kṛtāJṇjalirvākyamidam babhāṣe
verses.translation: Hearing these haughty from that demon, whose anger increased his ferocity, Mahodara the chief of warriors of demons, having offered obeisance with joined palms, spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: and whose anger increased his ferocity
the chief of warriors of demons

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गुणदोषौ विमृश्य च |
पश्चादपि महाबाहो शत्रून्युधि विजेष्यसि
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā guṇadoṣau vimṛśya ca |
paścādapi mahābāho śatrūnyudhi vijeṣyasi
verses.translation: "O, the mighty armed! When you have listened to the words of Ravana and considered the advantages and disadvantages of the matter, even afterwards you can conquer the enemies in battle."

glosses.meaning: the advantages and disadvantages (of the matter)

verses.devanagari:
महोदरवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसैः परिवारितः |
कुम्भकर्णो महातेजाः सम्प्रतस्थे महाबलः
verses.iast:
mahodaravacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ |
kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ sampratasthe mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Mahodara, the might Kumbhakarna of great valour prepared to depart, surrounded by demons.

verses.devanagari:
सुप्तमुत्थाप्य भीमाक्षम् भीमरूपपराक्रमम् |
राक्षसास्त्वरिता जग्मुर्दशग्रीवनिवेशनम्
verses.iast:
suptamutthāpya bhīmākṣam bhīmarūpaparākramam |
rākṣasāstvaritā jagmurdaśagrīvaniveśanam
verses.translation: The demons, having awaken that sleeping Kumbhakarna of dreadful eyes, form and valour, went to the King's palace in haste.

verses.devanagari:
तेऽभिगम्य दशग्रीवमासीनम् परमासने |
ऊचुर्बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सर्व एव निशाचराः
verses.iast:
te'bhigamya daśagrīvamāsīnam paramāsane |
ūcurbaddhāJṇjalipuṭāḥ sarva eva niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: All those demons, approaching Ravana who was seated on the throne, said to him with joined palms, as follows:

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णः प्रबुद्धोऽसौ भ्राता ते राक्षसेश्वर |
कथम् तत्रैव निर्यातु द्रक्ष्यसे तमिहागतम्
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇaḥ prabuddho'sau bhrātā te rākṣaseśvara |
katham tatraiva niryātu drakṣyase tamihāgatam
verses.translation: "O, Lord of Demons! Kumbhakarna, your brother, has wakened. Is it your will that he should enter the battle field from there itself or do you desire him to come here and see you?"

glosses.meaning: (It is your will) that he should enter the battle field
or do you desire to see

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टो राक्षसांस्तानुपस्थितान् |
द्रष्टुमेनमिहेच्छामि यथान्यायम् च पूज्यताम्
verses.iast:
rāvaṇastvabravīddhṛṣṭo rākṣasāṃstānupasthitān |
draṣṭumenamihecchāmi yathānyāyam ca pūjyatām
verses.translation: Ravana answered those demons who stood before him and with a glad heart, said: "I want to see him here. Bring him after extending the honours due to him in a befitting manner."

verses.devanagari:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे पुनरागम्य राक्षसाः |
कुम्भकर्णमिदम् वाक्यमूचू रावणचोदिताः
verses.iast:
tathetyuktvā tu te sarve punarāgamya rākṣasāḥ |
kumbhakarṇamidam vākyamūcū rāvaṇacoditāḥ
verses.translation: Uttering "Be it so", all those demons as commanded by Ravana, returned to Kumbhakarna and spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: as per the command of Ravana

verses.devanagari:
द्रष्टुम् त्वाम् काम्क्षते राजा सर्वराक्षसपुम्गवः |
गमने क्रियताम् बुद्धिर्भ्रातरम् सम्प्रहर्षय
verses.iast:
draṣṭum tvām kāmkṣate rājā sarvarākṣasapumgavaḥ |
gamane kriyatām buddhirbhrātaram sampraharṣaya
verses.translation: "The king, the lion of all the demons, desires to see you. Go and gratify your brother!"

glosses.meaning: the lion of all the dmeons

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुर्धर्षो भ्रातुराज्ञाय शासनम् |
तथेत्युक्त्वा महावीर्यः शयनादुत्पपात ह
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇastu durdharṣo bhrāturājJṇāya śāsanam |
tathetyuktvā mahāvīryaḥ śayanādutpapāta ha
verses.translation: Hearing his brother's wish, Kumbhakarna the inviolable demon of great prowess, uttering "so be it", leapt up from his couch.

verses.devanagari:
प्रक्षाल्य वदनम् ह्ऱ्^ष्टः स्नातः परमभूषितः |
पिपासुस्त्वरयामास पानम् बलसमीरणम्
verses.iast:
prakṣālya vadanam hR^ṣṭaḥ snātaḥ paramabhūṣitaḥ |
pipāsustvarayāmāsa pānam balasamīraṇam
verses.translation: Washing his face and bathing, refreshed and delighted, adorning himself well and feeling thirsty, he hastened them to bring him a drink which can boost up his strength.

glosses.meaning: which can boost up his strength.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्ते त्वरितास्तत्र राक्षसा रावणाज्ञया |
मद्यम् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् क्षिप्रमेवोपहारयन्
verses.iast:
tataste tvaritāstatra rākṣasā rāvaṇājJṇayā |
madyam bhakṣyāṃśca vividhān kṣipramevopahārayan
verses.translation: Thereupon, those demons brought him quickly the wine and various kinds of eatable there, in their hurry to take Kumbhakarna with them as per Ravana's commands.

verses.devanagari:
पीत्वा घटसहस्रे द्वे गमनायोपचक्रमे |
ईषत्समुत्कटो मत्तस्तेजोबलसमन्वितः
verses.iast:
pītvā ghaṭasahasre dve gamanāyopacakrame |
īṣatsamutkaṭo mattastejobalasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Having drunk two thousand pitchers, Kumbhakarna prepared to set out and slightly inebriated and flushed, he was exhilarated and filled with energy.

glosses.meaning: he was exhilarated and filled with energy.

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णो बबौ रुष्टः कालान्तकयमोपमः |
भ्रूतुः स भवनम् गच्छन् रक्षोबलसमन्वितः
कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् |
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇo babau ruṣṭaḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ |
bhrūtuḥ sa bhavanam gacchan rakṣobalasamanvitaḥ
kumbhakarṇaḥ padanyāsairakampayata medinīm |
verses.translation: The fuming Kumbhakarna, going to his brother's palace along with the army of demons, appeared like Yama the Lord of Death at the end of all-destroying Time. He caused the earth to tremble with his foot-steps, while marching.

glosses.meaning: along with the army of demons
like Yama the Lord of Death at the end of all-destroying time
he caused the earth to tremble

verses.devanagari:
स राजमार्गम् वपुषा प्रकाशयन् |
सहस्ररस्मिर्धरणीमिवांशुभिः |
जगाम तत्राञ्जलिमालया वृतः |
शतक्रतुर्गेहमिव स्वयम्भुवः
verses.iast:
sa rājamārgam vapuṣā prakāśayan |
sahasrarasmirdharaṇīmivāṃśubhiḥ |
jagāma tatrāJṇjalimālayā vṛtaḥ |
śatakraturgehamiva svayambhuvaḥ
verses.translation: The royal high way was illumined by his body, like unto that orb of a thousand rays (the sun) by its flashes illumines the earth and he went there, surrounded by a circle of demons paying obeisance, resembling Indra the Lord of Celestials approaching the abode of Brahma the Lord of Creation.

glosses.meaning: like unto that orb of a thousand rays (sund)
a circle of demons paying him obeisance
resembling Indra the Lord of Celestials
of Brahma the Lord of Creation.

verses.devanagari:
तम् राजमार्गस्थममित्रघातिनम् |
वनौकसस्ते सहसा बहिःस्थिताः |
दृष्ट्वाऽ प्रमेयम् गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम् |
वितत्रसुस्ते सह यूथपालैः
verses.iast:
tam rājamārgasthamamitraghātinam |
vanaukasaste sahasā bahiḥsthitāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā' prameyam giriśṛṇ^gakalpam |
vitatrasuste saha yūthapālaiḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that slayer of his foes on the royal high way, that monster as high as the peak of a mountain, those monkeys stationed outside the city, as also their leaders, were frightened suddenly.

glosses.meaning: as high as the peak of a mountain

verses.devanagari:
केचिछरण्यम् शरणम् स्म रामम् |
व्रजन्ति केचिद्व्यथिताः पतन्ति |
केचिद्दिशश्च व्यथिताः पतन्ति |
केचिद्बयार्ताभुवि शेरते स्म
verses.iast:
kecicharaṇyam śaraṇam sma rāmam |
vrajanti kecidvyathitāḥ patanti |
keciddiśaśca vyathitāḥ patanti |
kecidbayārtābhuvi śerate sma
verses.translation: Some gained refuge in Rama who affords protection, some fell down tottering, some fled away perturbed in all directions and some others lay on the ground, confounded with fear.

verses.devanagari:
तमद्रिशृङ्गप्रतिमम् किरीटिनम् |
स्पृशन्तमादित्यमिवात्मतेजसा |
वनौकसः प्रेक्ष्य विवृद्धमद्भुतम् |
भयार्दिता दुद्रुविरे यतस्ततः
verses.iast:
tamadriśṛṇ^gapratimam kirīṭinam |
spṛśantamādityamivātmatejasā |
vanaukasaḥ prekṣya vivṛddhamadbhutam |
bhayārditā dudruvire yatastataḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that colossus appearing like a great peak, having a diadem who seemed to touch the sun with his brilliance, the monkeys were seized with terror and had grown immensely in size, fled hither and thither.

glosses.meaning: and had grown immensely in size
